rejected_lenses.reason: Rejected as an overbroad regression umbrella. Its concrete command-routing case is already covered by interaction-command-collision; the remaining claim does not identify a distinct failure mode.
Merged into discovery-content-fidelity and synthesis-format-contract. The proposed corpus strengthens testing but does not define a materially distinct externally observable failure.
Rejected as a process-traceability quality claim rather than a distinct, externally observable export failure with a direct material outcome.

audit_summary: Accepted nine materially distinct lenses covering export scope, content preservation, command routing, destination behavior, empty results, representation, ordering, source immutability, and incomplete artifacts. All twelve proposals were dispositioned; two were rejected as vague or overbroad and one was merged as duplicate test coverage.
